# Evans Ademilua

> Evans Ademilua is a full stack developer and web developer and the CEO of Large Technologies, based in Lagos, Nigeria. He is also known as Olufemi Evans Ademilua, Olufemi Ademilua and Evans Large. He builds websites, web apps, booking systems, client portals, internal dashboards, workflow automation and AI features for businesses. Top Rated on Upwork with eight 5-star client reviews.

- [Full stack developer for hire](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/full-stack-developer/): what he builds, the stack he uses and how to hire him
- [Web developer in Lagos, Nigeria](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/web-developer/): websites and web apps for businesses worldwide
- [Free online tools](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/): video, audio, PDF, image and QR code tools that run in the browser
- [Video editor](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/video-editor/): Cut, add auto captions, text, music and filters, then export an MP4. Works on your phone.
- [QR code generator](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/qr-code-generator/): Links, text, WiFi, WhatsApp, email, phone, SMS, location and contact cards. Add a logo and colors.
- [Second screen presenter](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/second-screen-presenter/): Bible verses, lyrics, PDFs, videos, cameras and countdowns on a TV or projector, with a stage display and phone remote.
- [Background remover](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/remove-background/): Remove the background from any image. Exact for logos, AI cutout for photos. Transparent PNG.
- [Video compressor](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/video-compressor/): Shrink a big video, like 2 GB down to 500 MB. Trim it or cut it into two parts.
- [WhatsApp QR code and link](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/whatsapp-qr-code-generator/): A click-to-chat link and QR code with an optional message already typed.
- [QR code scanner](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/qr-code-scanner/): Read a code from a photo, a screenshot or your camera. Nothing is uploaded.
- [WiFi QR code generator](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/wifi-qr-code-generator/): Let guests join your network with one scan. Print a clean sign for your wall.
- [Audio editor and recorder](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/audio-editor/): Multi-track audio editor. Import stems, edit, record over them and export WAV, MP3 or a ZIP.
- [Color picker](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/color-picker/): Pick a color, copy HEX, RGB, HSL and CMYK, pull a palette from a photo, check contrast.
- [Currency calculator](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/currency-calculator/): Convert between about 160 currencies with live reference rates, a margin option and a pinned table.
- [Image converter and compressor](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/image-converter/): Convert HEIC, PNG, WebP, AVIF and more to JPG, PNG or WebP. Shrink images in batches.
- [Image to PDF](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/image-to-pdf/): Turn JPG, PNG and WebP images into one PDF. Reorder, rotate, pick page size.
- [Invoice generator](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/invoice-generator/): Make a clean invoice with your logo, VAT and bank details. Download a PDF or send it on WhatsApp.
- [Merge PDF](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/merge-pdf/): Combine several PDFs into one. Reorder files and pick page ranges. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Receipt generator](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/receipt-generator/): Make a sales receipt for a till roll (80 mm) or an A5 or A4 page. PDF, print or WhatsApp.
- [Screen recorder](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/screen-recorder/): Record your screen, a window or a tab with sound and a webcam circle. Save WebM or MP4.
- [Split PDF](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/split-pdf/): Extract, delete or rotate pages, or split a PDF by ranges or every N pages. Private.
- [Video converter](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/video-converter/): Convert video between MP4, WebM, MKV and MOV, or save the audio as MP3 or WAV.
- [Video to MP3](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/video-to-mp3/): Pull the sound out of any video and save it as MP3 or WAV. Choose the bitrate, trim if you like.
- [Video trimmer](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/video-trimmer/): Cut a video in seconds without re-encoding. Keep a selection or split it into two parts.
- [Watermark maker](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/watermark-maker/): Add a text or logo watermark to one or many photos. Tile it or place it, then download a ZIP.
- [WhatsApp link generator](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/whatsapp-link-generator/): Make a wa.me click-to-chat link with a ready message, plus a QR code. Copy as a link or button.
